name: Can I live in my home during a kitchen expansion?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a kitchen expansion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Living in your home during a kitchen expansion is possible but challenging, as your kitchen will be a construction zone for an extended period. This means no functional kitchen for cooking, limited access to water, and ongoing noise, dust, and disruption. Many homeowners opt to set up a temporary kitchenette elsewhere in the house or arrange for alternative living arrangements, especially during the demolition and rough-in phases. Your contractor can help plan for dust control and temporary utility access to minimize inconvenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living at home during a kitchen expansion is challenging due to disruption; consider temporary living arrangements or a makeshift kitchen elsewhere in the house.
